description: Gold analytical table containing one row per ICU stay per clinical date. It summarises ICU context, patient demographics, vital-sign monitoring, laboratory activity, fluid balance, procedures and dataset-relative activity indicators. The source data comes from the deidentified MIMIC-IV research dataset, and dates are shifted.
grain: One row per ICU stay per clinical date.

hadm_id.description: Hospital admission identifier associated with the ICU stay.

clinical_date.description: Calendar date represented by this ICU monitoring row. Together with stay_id, defines the grain of the table.

icu_day_number.description: Sequential ICU day number beginning at 1 on the ICU admission date.

gender.description: Recorded patient gender from the MIMIC-IV patient table.

age_at_admission.description: Derived patient age at the time of hospital admission.

age_group.description: Derived age band based on age at hospital admission.

admission_type.description: Hospital admission type associated with the ICU stay.

admission_mortality_flag.description: Indicates whether the patient died during the overall hospital admission. This is an admission-level outcome repeated across ICU days.

icu_careunit.description: Care unit associated with the ICU stay. Used as the main care-unit dimension for ICU analysis.

security_careunit.description: Care-unit field intended for care-unit-based row-level security.

icu_los_days.description: Recorded ICU length of stay in days.

icu_stay_complete.description: Indicates whether an ICU outtime is available for the stay.

vital_observation_count.description: Number of retained bedside vital-sign observations recorded for the ICU stay-day.

distinct_vital_measurements.description: Number of selected vital-sign concepts available for the day, from 0 to 4: heart rate, respiratory rate, SpO2 and temperature.

vital_warning_count.description: Number of selected vital observations carrying the source warning indicator.

vital_warning_flag.description: True when at least one selected vital observation has a source warning indicator.

heart_rate_avg.description: Daily average heart rate in beats per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

heart_rate_min.description: Daily minimum heart rate in beats per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

heart_rate_max.description: Daily maximum heart rate in beats per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

resp_rate_avg.description: Daily average respiratory rate in breaths per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

resp_rate_min.description: Daily minimum respiratory rate in breaths per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

resp_rate_max.description: Daily maximum respiratory rate in breaths per minute after broad plausibility filtering.

spo2_avg.description: Daily average pulse oximetry oxygen saturation percentage after broad plausibility filtering.

spo2_min.description: Daily minimum pulse oximetry oxygen saturation percentage after broad plausibility filtering.

spo2_max.description: Daily maximum pulse oximetry oxygen saturation percentage after broad plausibility filtering.

temperature_c_avg.description: Daily average temperature in degrees Celsius. Fahrenheit observations are converted to Celsius.

temperature_c_min.description: Daily minimum temperature in degrees Celsius.

temperature_c_max.description: Daily maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.

lab_result_count.description: Number of retained selected laboratory results for the ICU stay-day.

distinct_lab_tests.description: Number of selected laboratory concepts represented on the ICU stay-day.

abnormal_lab_count.description: Number of selected laboratory results explicitly flagged as abnormal in the source data.

abnormal_lab_flag.description: True when at least one selected laboratory result is explicitly flagged as abnormal.

creatinine_avg.description: Daily average blood creatinine result in mg/dL.

hemoglobin_avg.description: Daily average blood hemoglobin result in g/dL.

wbc_avg.description: Daily average blood white blood cell count in K/uL.

sodium_avg.description: Daily average blood sodium result in mEq/L.

potassium_avg.description: Daily average blood potassium result in mEq/L.

lactate_avg.description: Daily average blood lactate result in mmol/L after removal of clearly corrupted extreme values.

fluid_input_recorded.description: Indicates whether retained ICU fluid input data is available for the stay-day.

fluid_output_recorded.description: Indicates whether retained ICU fluid output data is available for the stay-day.

fluid_input_ml.description: Total retained ICU fluid input allocated to the clinical day in millilitres.

fluid_output_ml.description: Total retained ICU fluid output recorded on the clinical day in millilitres.

net_fluid_balance_ml.description: Daily fluid input minus fluid output in millilitres. Populated only when both input and output are recorded.

fluid_balance_complete.description: True when both retained fluid input and retained fluid output are available for the stay-day.

fluid_balance_direction.description: Direction of daily fluid balance: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, BALANCED or INCOMPLETE.

procedure_count.description: Number of ICU procedure orders beginning on the clinical day.

distinct_procedure_types.description: Number of distinct procedure item IDs beginning on the clinical day.

high_vital_monitoring_flag.description: Dataset-relative analytical flag for ICU days with at least 104 retained vital observations, based on approximately the 95th percentile. Not a clinical risk threshold.

high_lab_activity_flag.description: Dataset-relative analytical flag for ICU days with at least 17 selected lab results, based on approximately the 95th percentile. Not a clinical risk threshold.

high_procedure_activity_flag.description: Dataset-relative analytical flag for ICU days with at least 8 procedures, based on approximately the 95th percentile. Not a clinical risk threshold.

large_fluid_imbalance_flag.description: Dataset-relative analytical flag where absolute complete daily fluid balance is at least 4465.29 mL, approximately the 95th percentile. Not a clinical risk threshold.

_gold_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the Gold table row was generated.
